meta.frame: body: x forward, y left, z up; level body = world; origin = CAD origin; q = [uz, roll, pitch] about the origin
meta.sign: forces + = compression / floor pushes up; pitch + = nose down (rotation about +y); roll + = left side (+y) up (rotation about +x)
meta.time_origin: t = 0 at motor start; e(t) = min(v t, stroke) on all four legs
meta.model:
same family as reference.json ``lift_V4_compliant_crawler``, dyn_model.static_unilateral):
  * rigid superstructure (auger level top, mass case C) + 4 rod/pad moving parts, vertical 3-DoF
    q = [uz, roll, pitch] about the body-frame origin (small angles, x/y/yaw fixed),
  * rigid level floor at ground.crawler_bottom_z_m,
  * 4 unilateral pad springs, k = contact.rigid_floor.L1.kn_per_pad_N_m (oil column + rod + frame +
    concrete in series, L1 lumped), placed at the pad bottom centres,
  * crawler layout D (dyn_model.crawler_points / crawler_gaps, YAML contact.crawler.*): 2 x 6 roller
    stations on the floor + 2 x 6 raised end shoes as unilateral springs with an initial gap; kn_total x3
    sensitivity block (contact.crawler.kn_total_sensitivity_range_N_m, dashpot x sqrt(3), same heave zeta),
  * all legs e(t) = min(v t, stroke), v = actuator.max_speed_m_s, t = 0 at motor start,
  * quasi-static (rate effects neglected; checked by a damped 3-DoF time integration through the
    transition, section "quasi_static_check").
meta.cylinder_force_definition: F_cyl = F_pad - m_rod g (oil column force, + compression). Leg in the air: F_cyl = -m_rod g; head pressure sensor p = max(F_cyl,0)/A_head (rod side carries the hanging rod; seal friction neglected)

V4_reproduction.note: reference rounds to 5 significant digits; end_cyl vs YAML differs because YAML uses equal leg stiffness (front/rear kn differ by 2 %)

quasi_static_check (damped 3-DoF).model: M = m a a^T + blockdiag(0, I_xy) with a = [1, cg_y, -cg_x] (CoM vertical velocity), I_xy = roll/pitch block of the inertia about the CoM (horizontal CoM motion from rotation neglected). Unilateral spring-dampers: F = max(0, k c + c_d c_dot) for c > 0 (YAML cn_per_pad, crawler damping_total / n_roller). Gravity on the combined CoM. Integrator DOP853 (non-stiff: highest mode ~10 Hz), max_step 1 ms (contact switching).
quasi_static_check (damped 3-DoF).initial_condition: quasi-static pose on the crawler at t = 14.5 s, body velocity 0 (pads still in the air)

quasi_static_check_leg_zeta_sensitivity.description: dynamic check repeated with the pad dashpots scaled to leg zeta (heave basis); crawler damping kept at the YAML value; F_min margin = min over legs of the cylinder force after it first reaches F_min, minus F_min

stiffness_sensitivity_k_oil_of_extension.description: kn(e) = 1/(1/kn_yaml + 1/k_oil(e) - 1/k_oil(e_op)), k_oil = beta A_head/(dead + e) (YAML actuator), evaluated at e = stroke

crawler_kn_total_x3_sensitivity.description: crawler kn_total x 3 (contact.crawler.kn_total_sensitivity_range_N_m), crawler dashpot x sqrt(3) (same heave zeta), layout D, pads and everything else unchanged

series.columns: rows = time samples (0.01 s, plus 1 ms in 14.8-16.2 s); per-leg columns FL, FR, RL, RR
